name: lilact
description: A Little React/JSX Runtime Implementation for Browser

scripts.doc: cross-env MODE=development MINIFY=false node scripts/preprocess.mjs && node scripts/copy-dist-to-examples.mjs && npx typedoc --out docs --tsconfig tsconfig.json && bin/copy-demo.js
scripts.build:debug: cross-env MODE=development MINIFY=false node scripts/preprocess.mjs && cross-env MODE=development MINIFY=false node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.build:release: cross-env MODE=production MINIFY=false node scripts/preprocess.mjs && cross-env MODE=production MINIFY=false node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.build:debug.min: cross-env MODE=development MINIFY=true node scripts/preprocess.mjs && cross-env MODE=development MINIFY=true node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.build:release.min: cross-env MODE=production MINIFY=true node scripts/preprocess.mjs && cross-env MODE=production MINIFY=true node scripts/build.mjs

author: Arash Kazemi <contact.arash.kazemi@gmail.com>
